tasks.build: deno task build:auth && deno task build:settings
tasks.build:auth: deno run -A npm:rolldown static/js/auth.ts --file static/js/auth.js --format iife --minify
tasks.build:settings: deno run -A npm:rolldown static/js/settings.ts --file static/js/settings.js --format iife --minify
tasks.check: deno task lint && deno task typecheck
